affected.product: HT Mega Addons for Elementor – Elementor Widgets & Template Builder

descriptions.value: The HT Mega Addons for Elementor – Elementor Widgets & Template Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Data Table 'display_options' Setting in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

descriptions.description: CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

assertions.title: HT Mega Addons for Elementor <= 3.1.1 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Data Table 'display_options' Setting
